description: Extrapolate released C4 loss learning curves to each run's largest observed training-token checkpoint.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: Source-reported loss; smaller values represent better performance.

measurement_provenance.method: exact released entries; where multiple rows have an identical independent scale within a curve, retain the exact row with minimum released C4 evaluation loss
measurement_provenance.selection: all released checkpoints, separated into intended training runs
measurement_provenance.target_semantics: C4 evaluation loss (the released loss column)
